delete.title: Delete tag?
delete.question: Are you sure you want to permanently delete {{ tagName }}?
delete.leafMessage: This action cannot be undone. Deletion may be blocked while this tag is still used by an active workflow.

status.label: Status

errors.inactiveReference: An inactive tag cannot be assigned to a new record. Reactivate it first.
